m400239.強そうなオークさんが沢山いたので、\nとっても激しい戦いになると予想します！\n: There are a lot of tough-looking orcs, so I'm expecting a really fierce battle! Please, don't be reckless…
m400239.急いで王子に報告するため戻ろうとしたら、\n見つかってしまって……。\nオークの: I rushed back to tell you, but they spotted me… and the orc chieftain captured me.
m400239.更に、今回のミッションは、\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまでに\n倒: Moreover, this mission counts as cleared even if our life reaches zero, and the number of foes we've slain will be recorded as our achievement.
m400239.王子、ご報告があって参りました！: Prince, I have a report for you!
m400239.王子も有名になると、オークさんが魔界から\n戦いに挑んで来たりするのですね……。: So once the Prince becomes famous, even orcs from the demon realm will come to challenge us… Thankfully they're polite orcs.
m400239.討伐に向かう……ですか。分かりました！\nでは、これからの戦いについて説明を致し: You want to go on a hunt? Understood! Then let me explain the upcoming battle.

m400247.…………ありがとう。\nやっぱり優しいね、王子は。: ..........Thank you. As I thought, you're kind, Prince.
m400247.……ううん、偶然なんかじゃないよ。\nあれだけの数の天使が一か所に集まるのはね、: ...No, it's not a coincidence. For that many angels to assemble in one spot, it can only be when the Archangel General calls a summons.
m400247.……うん、そうだよ。\n天使兵団には冷酷な天使しかいない……。\n奴らは、神の名: ...That's right. The Angel Legion is made up of only ruthless angels... They come to annihilate humans in God's name.
m400247.……え？\nそれだけなら大した問題じゃないだろうって？\n……そうは言っていられ: ...Huh? You think that's no big deal? ...I can't just say that, Prince.
m400247.あの……王子。\nくれぐれも気をつけてね？\n相手は強力な天使ばかりだと思うから: Um… Prince, please be careful, okay? The foes are all powerful angels, after all…
m400247.このミッションは、ライフが0になってもクリア扱いだよ。\nその際は、倒した敵の数: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared. The number of enemies you defeat will be recorded as your result, so focus on slaying as many as you can.
m400247.それじゃあ、王子。\nこれからの戦いについての説明をしておくよ。\nとても大事な: Alright then, Prince. Let me explain the upcoming battle. It's very important, so listen carefully.
m400247.それでは、『大討伐ミッション』を開始するよ。: Then, let's begin the Grand Hunt Mission.
m400247.だから……王子に頼み事があるの。\n天使たちが暴れだす前に奴らを退治してほしいん: So... I have a favor to ask, Prince. I need you to eliminate them before they start rampaging.
m400247.でも、ミッション中は出撃コストが回復しないから、\n援軍を呼ぶ事に長けていて、\: But during the mission your deployment cost won't recover, so it's best to field units that excel at calling in reinforcements and can restore that cost.
m400247.もちろん、命令に反発する天使もいるけど、\nそんな事をすれば、私みたいに堕天使と: Of course, some angels rebel against that order, but if they do, they're branded as fallen angels—just like me—and hunted by the rest of the angels...
m400247.今回の戦いは、一人でも多くの敵を倒す事を目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』なんだ: This fight is a "Grand Hunt Mission" aimed at defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400247.千年戦争時代に、天使が封印されていた事は知ってるよね。\nその封印は、いろいろな: You know that during the Millennium War, angels were sealed away, right? Those seals were placed in many places, but now they've all been broken...
m400247.大天使長が、召集をかけるという事は、\nその天使兵団が結成されているという事でも: When the Archangel General issues a summons, it means the Angel Legion is being formed.
m400247.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションと違って\n『敵を撃破すること』のみが目的とな: Unlike regular missions, the only objective here is to defeat enemies, so taking down foes is more important than protecting our own forces.
m400247.天使兵団って知ってる？\n千年戦争時代に人間を滅ぼす為に、天界から\n派兵された: Have you heard of the Angel Legion? It's a force composed of angels dispatched from the heavens during the Millennium War to wipe out humanity.
m400247.実は、これから人間にとって大変な事が起こるから、\n報告しなきゃと思ってここに来: Actually, something huge is about to happen to humanity, so I came here to report it.
m400247.封印を解除された天使達の行方なんだけど、\nどうも、一か所に集結しているみたいな: As for the angels whose seals were broken, they seem to be gathering in one place.
m400247.最後に、敵を倒してもEXP、ドロップ品、ゴールドは\n入手する事ができないから、: One more thing: even if you defeat enemies you won't earn any EXP, drops, or gold, so keep that in mind.
m400247.王子、ニエルだけど……失礼するね。\nえっと、少しだけ私の話を聞いて欲しいんだ。: Prince, it's Niel... excuse me. Um, I just need you to listen to me for a moment.
m400247.私達天使にはね……遠い昔に、\n神から「人間を滅ぼせ」という命令が下っているんだ: You see, us angels received a command from God ages ago: "Destroy humanity."

m400356.ここは地形を熟知している田園で敵を迎え討つ他に\n手立てはありません。: The only option is to meet them here, where we know the terrain best.
m400356.すでに敵は田園を襲撃するための布陣を整えています。\n敵陣に攻め込むのは危険です: They're already setting up their formation to raid the fields. Attacking their camp would be too risky.
m400356.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.

m400356.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This battle will be a "Grand Annihilation Mission" focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400356.今回は敵が奇襲してきます。\n敵の動きが通常よりも速いのでお気を付けください。: This time the enemies will launch a surprise attack, moving faster than usual, so stay alert.
m400356.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—concentrate on taking down as many monsters as you can.
m400356.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400356.敵の大部隊が田園近くに展開しているとの報告が\n入りました。: We've received reports that a large enemy force is deploying near the fields.
m400356.王子、田園を守るため『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission to protect the fields!
m400356.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: It's more important to kill as many foes as possible than to keep our own losses low.
m400356.被害を最小限にするため、すでに放棄された居住区に\nわが軍の陣地を用意しました。: To minimize casualties, we've prepared our own positions in the abandoned residential area.

m400361.しかも、現れた妖怪たちの数は千体にも及ぶと言われ、\n百鬼夜行ならぬ、千鬼夜行の: Moreover, the number of youkai that have appeared is said to be in the thousands—it's not just a Hundred Demons Parade, but a Thousand Demons Night.
m400361.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Consequently, deployment costs won't recover over time, so be sure to include anyone with the "Request Reinforcements" skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400361.その百鬼夜行が実際に東の国で行われ、\n妖怪の群れが居住区に向っているという報告: We've received reports that such a parade is actually happening in the Eastern lands, with a horde of youkai heading toward the settlements.
m400361.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or item drops.
m400361.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the only objective is to destroy the enemies.
m400361.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life gauge drops to zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be recorded as your achievement.
m400361.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This battle will be a "Grand Annihilation Mission," focused solely on defeating the enemies.
m400361.今回は急な遠征のため思うように\n部隊が展開できません。: Because this is a sudden expedition, we can't deploy our forces as we'd like.
m400361.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—devote yourself to cutting down as many monsters as possible.
m400361.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400361.王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400361.王子、妖怪から東の国の人たちを守るためにも\n千鬼夜行を止めに行きましょう！: Prince, we must stop this Thousand Demons Night to protect the people of the East from the youkai!
m400361.王子。百鬼夜行という言葉をご存知ですか……？\n集団でさまよう妖怪たちのことを指: Prince, have you ever heard of the "Hundred Demons Parade"? It's the term for a swarm of wandering youkai.
m400361.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: Rather than minimizing our own casualties, the priority is how many foes we can eliminate.

m400431.――へぶっ……こ、転んじゃいました……。\nじゃなくて大変なんですよー！\n魔法: Ugh... I... I fell... No, that's not it! It's terrible! A massive number of golems have gone berserk in the Magic City!!
m400431.……うぅっ、ぐすっ、ありがとうございますっ！\nやっぱり王子様が一番頼りになりま: ...Ugh, sniff, thank you! As always, you're the most reliable, Your Highness!!
m400431.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ方を\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れないでくださいね: Don't forget to put someone with the “Request Reinforcements” skill on your deployment team!
m400431.あっ！ あと敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできま: Oh! And even if you defeat enemies, you won't receive any EXP, gold, or drops!
m400431.あまりにも多くの敵が襲撃してくる為、\n大討伐ミッションでは、とにかく\n『多く: Because hordes of enemies will pour in, the goal of the Grand Hunt is simply to defeat as many foes as possible!
m400431.かつてのゴーレムは魔法都市の守護者でしたが、\n今では魔物の魂に取り憑かれ、\n: Those golems were once the city's guardians, but now they're possessed by monster souls, turning them into spearheads that aim to purge the humans of the Magic City.
m400431.さらには、急な侵攻に対する出兵ですので、\n出撃コストが時間経過では回復しません: And since this is a rapid response deployment, the sortie cost won't recover over time...
m400431.そして今回は、件の自律行動しているゴーレムが、\n都市深部の研究施設で、大量のゴ: And this time, those autonomous golems apparently activated a huge number of their kind in a deep research facility, marching them toward the human settlements...
m400431.その上、その研究施設では自然に宿る元素の\n研究もしていた為か、ゴーレムに加え、: On top of that, because the facility was also studying natural elements, elementals have started appearing alongside the golems!
m400431.それから、ライフが０になってもクリアになって、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウントさ: Also, even if your life hits zero, the mission still counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain up to that point will be recorded as your achievement.
m400431.だから損耗を抑えることよりも、\n少しでも多くの敵を撃破することを優先してくださ: So prioritize racking up kills over conserving resources!
m400431.で、では出立の前に、今回の戦いについての補足を。\n普段より規模の大きな『大討伐: Now, before we set out, a quick briefing on this battle. It'll be a larger-scale 'Grand Hunt Mission' than usual!!
m400431.もうこうなっては、魔法都市の住人だけでは\nとても対抗できそうになくて……。\n: At this rate, the city's residents alone can't possibly stand up to this... Please, Your Highness, lend us your strength!!
m400431.わっひゃぁああっ！？\n大変大変、大変なんです王子様ぁー！！: Wahhh!? This is terrible, terrible, it's urgent, Your Highness!!
m400431.中には取り憑いた魔物の意志が強く反映され、\n自律的に判断、行動するゴーレムもい: Some are even heavily influenced by the monster's will, acting autonomously, which is a matter of life and death for the city's inhabitants.
m400431.伝説にまで謳われる魔法都市には、\n古来より星の数程のゴーレムがいることは、\n: You must know, Your Highness, that the legendary Magic City has been said to house countless golems—like as many as the stars—since ancient times.
m400431.激しい戦いになるかと思いますが、\n王子様たちならきっと勝利すると信じています。: It's going to be a fierce fight, but I'm sure you, Prince, will emerge victorious. Please go ahead and launch the Grand Hunt Mission!
m400431.王子様たちの活躍で、魔法都市の生き残りが\n暮らしている地域のゴーレムは一掃され: Thanks to you and the others, the golems in the surviving districts have been cleared, but countless golems still remain throughout the city.

m400517.――まさか、ハロウィンパーティの会場を、\nそのまま迎撃拠点に流用することになる: I never thought we'd have to turn the Halloween party venue into a defense base… and that it's because of a world-ending crisis.
m400517.――分かりました。\n皆さんが戦うと決めたのなら、\nわたくしも全力で助力します: Very well. If you've decided to fight, I'll give you my full support!
m400517.…………いて。\nお願い、わたくしの声よ、届いて……。: …please. My voice… let it reach you…
m400517.……しかし皆さまは、見事彼奴の尖兵を撃破されました。\nわたくしの考えが間違いで: …But you spectacularly destroyed his vanguard, proving with force that my reasoning was wrong.
m400517.……ん？ あれ？ おかしいですね。\nなんだか急に「門」に変なノイズが──: …hmm? Huh? Something's off. Suddenly the Gate's picking up weird noise—
m400517.──ええい、まったくキリがない！\n兜でもここまでしつこくはないぞ！？: Ugh, this is never ending! Not even a helmet would be this relentless!
m400517.──にゃふふふふ、祭りの準備も終わりそうかな？: —nya fufufufu, I wonder if the festival preparations are finally finished?
m400517.──もちろん行くわよ、それが王国だもの。: Of course we'll go—it's what the kingdom does.
m400517.──未解析の情報生命体を複数確認。\n次元調査規定に基づきアナライズシステムを起:
—Multiple unknown informational lifeforms detected.
Activating analysis system per dimensional survey regulations.
Requesting permission to capture the targets for detailed examination…
m400517.──次元空間に熱源反応、偵察ビーコンの出撃を許可。: —Heat source detected in dimensional space; authorizing deployment of reconnaissance beacons.
m400517.──私たちが道を開くわ！ そのまま行って！: —We'll clear the way! Just go ahead!
m400517.「門」の使用には日の本の千狐さんの力が不可欠。\n異世界の方々にあまりご迷惑を掛: Using the “Gate” requires the power of the thousand foxes of Nippon. We mustn't trouble the people of other worlds too much.
m400517.『先行偵察ビーコンによる現地調査を開始する』: 【Initiating local survey via forward reconnaissance beacon】
m400517.『情報体の転送と再構築の所要時間を計測中──』: 【Measuring the time required for data transfer and reconstruction—】
m400517.『次元間航行に不明なエラーを確認。\n目標地点到達までの時刻を下方修正──』: 【Detected an unknown error in interdimensional travel. Adjusting ETA downward—】
m400517.『私のおかげ』と言うか『お前のせい』だけどな。: “Thanks to me,” huh? More like “because of you.”
m400517.ああ、私の調査結果によると、\n奴が前線指揮官で間違いない。: Yes. My research shows he's definitely the frontline commander.
m400517.あれ？ なにか声が聞こえてきたような……？: Huh? I think I heard a voice…?
m400517.いいえ、あれはホロウクルスの幻影。\n莫大な情報量を保有する彼奴は、\n次元間の: No, that's just an illusion of Holooculus. That being holds massive data, so even interdimensional travel takes time.
m400517.いいえ、それだけではありません。\n取り込んだ現地生命体に自身の情報を上書きし、: No, that's not all. It also has the ability to overwrite the data of native lifeforms it assimilates, bringing them under its control.
m400517.いえ……これは、別次元からの交信──？: No… this is communication from another dimension—?
m400517.うんうん、無事に開催できそうでなによりだよー。: Yeah, yeah, it's great that it looks like we can hold it safely.
m400517.おうじょう……王城か！ 城の化身だな？\n英傑の塔とアイギス神殿の資料なら以前読: Royal Castle… so that's you! The embodiment of a castle? I've read about the Heroic Tower and Aegis Temple before—you're like a castle maiden, yet not one.
m400517.おそらくは皆さまの世界の情報を吸収し、\n学習したものかと思われます。\n今回の: It appears to have absorbed information from your world and learned from it. In this case, it's a Halloween party, right?
m400517.おっ、良好良好。\nいいね、頭に直接たわーの声が聞こえる感じだ。: Oh, all good. Nice, it's like hearing Tawa's voice straight in my head.
m400517.このまま迫る敵を倒し続けるだけでは、\n物量に押し潰されるのが目に見えています。: If we just keep slashing at the enemies as they come, we'll be crushed by sheer numbers.
m400517.この国の象徴にして、歴史そのもの。\n建物に宿る「記憶と神秘」を核にして、\n疑: It's the very symbol of this nation, its history itself. Using the “memories and mysteries” embedded in the building as its core, a pseudo-physical weapon was born—
m400517.この戦いに終止符を、ホロウクルスを倒すのです！: We will put an end to this battle by defeating Hollow Crus!
m400517.これから皆さまには各世界の拠点にて、\n現在次元間を高速で航行中の、\nホロウク: From now on, you'll be intercepting the rapidly-traveling minions of Holooculus at each world's base.
m400517.これはまた……何かと物騒ですね。\nしかし、すべての世界の勇士たちが集まれば、\: Well now… that's quite ominous. But with heroes from every world gathered, nothing can scare us.
m400517.しかし、あまりに強すぎるエネルギーが、\n幻として各世界に顕現しているのでしょう: But its overwhelming energy is manifesting as an illusion across the worlds.
m400517.しかし、ある日突然見知らぬ相手から、\n自分たちの世界を捨てろと言われたところで: Yet, if some stranger suddenly told us to abandon our world, that's hardly a story we could accept.
m400517.しかし、ホロウクルスは強大な存在です。\n可能なら、今すぐ別の世界に避難して――: However, Holooculus is a far more powerful entity. If possible, evacuate to another world immediately—
m400517.その前に三つの世界の総力を結集し、\n全ての根源を断つしか道はありません。: Before that, we must pool the strength of the three worlds and cut off the source completely.
m400517.それが私！ 王城ってわけね！: That's me! So I'm the Royal Castle!
m400517.それでは早速ですが、現在の状況と、\n今後の作戦について説明いたしますね。: Alright, let me quickly brief you on the current situation and our upcoming strategy.
m400517.それはもう言っても仕方がない。\n一夜城にしてはむしろ立派な方だろうさ。\n下手: Hard to argue with that. For a one-night castle, it's actually pretty impressive. Since we aren't putting on a fake show, it's easier to calculate.
m400517.そんなにも危険な存在だったなんて……。\nこの戦い絶対に負けるわけにはいきません: I never realized it was that dangerous… We can't afford to lose this battle.
m400517.たかが数日で堅牢な砦を用意するなど、\nそんな夢のようなことできるわけが──: Preparing a solid fortress in just a few days? That's a pipe dream.
m400517.つまり、敵の本拠地に殴り込みをかけるってわけね？: In other words, we're going to launch a direct assault on the enemy's stronghold, right?
m400517.ですのでわたくしも、覚悟を決めました。\n皆さまにホロウクルスの倒し方をお教えし: So I've made my decision, too. I'll teach you how to defeat the Hollow Crus.
m400517.ですので今回の戦いは、わたくしからすれば、\n世界を諦めてもらうための儀式のつも: So, from my perspective, this battle was meant to be a ritual—to make you give up on the world.
m400517.どうした？ ようやく本音を話す気になったか？: What's wrong? Finally decided to speak your mind?
m400517.な、なんですかー！？ みんなノリノリだったくせにー！: W-what's that—?! Everyone was so into it!
m400517.なぜカボチャの姿なのでしょう……？: Why does it take the form of a pumpkin…?
m400517.にゃはは、だからって捨て身の突撃かい？\n城娘ってのは粋なことを考えるもんだよ。: Nyahaha, so it's a suicide charge? Castle maidens always think of such stylish moves.
m400517.にゃふ、こいつは長い夜になりそうだ。: Nyah, looks like this one's gonna be a long night.
m400517.にゃふふ、まだまだ先は長いだろうが、\n序章の終わり方としては上等な部類かな？: Nyfufu, the road's still long, but as an ending to the prologue, that's pretty solid, huh?
m400517.はい、今まで隠すような真似をして申し訳ございません。: Yes, I apologize for having kept things hidden until now.

m400517.コンッ！？ アレはなんなの！？\nみなさん！ 見てください！\n空に謎の巨大な影: What!? What is that!? Everyone! Look! There's a massive mysterious shadow in the sky…!!

I will open the gate to the world's distortion.
May you all have good fortune in battle, and—
m400517.以前皆さまは、同じく超次元生命体である、\nプルラルクルスを撃破されたと\nわた: Previously, you all defeated a similar hyper-dimensional lifeform, the Pluralculus, according to my pre-restart observation logs.

m400517.全てはあらゆる環境に適応するため。\n超次元生命体は異世界へと侵攻するに際し、\: All of this is to adapt to any environment. When a hyper-dimensional lifeform invades another world, it reshapes its body into the optimal form.
m400517.分かりました。どっかーんからのごっつーんですね？: Understood. So it's a big boom from somewhere, right?
m400517.危機的状況だ、すぐに出られるか？: We're in a critical situation—can you get out right away?

m400517.当然、私の王子には勝利こそ相応しいのよ！: Naturally, victory is what my Prince deserves!

m400517.無回答──緊急時行動規定を採用、行動を開始。: No response—activating emergency protocols, commencing action.
m400517.王子、あなたの誓いは私が守ってみせる！: Prince, I'll keep the oath you made!
m400517.現在、皆さまの世界に、\n超次元生命体ホロウクルスが接近しています。: Right now, a hyper-dimensional lifeform called Holooculus is approaching your world.
m400517.異世界への侵略──すなわち広義の破廉恥！: Invasion of another world—essentially a grand act of shamelessness!
m400517.発音が難しいと思いますので、\nたわーとお呼びください。: The pronunciation is tricky, so just call me “Tawā.”

m400517.目標はホロウパンプキンデウス、ね？: The target is Hollow Pumpkin Deus, right?

m400517.身を以てホロウクルスの恐ろしさを知ってもらえたなら、\n皆さまもきっと、別の世界: If you truly experience the horror of the Hollow Crus, I thought you'd choose to evacuate to another world.
m400517.陥落の屈辱も、敗北の絶望も一度で十分。: One humiliation of falling, one despair of defeat—that's enough.

m400517.（いける……敵は本隊でないとはいえ、\nホロウクルスの軍勢を相手に勝っている……: T.O.W.E.R.: (We can do it… even though they're not the main force, we're beating the Hollow Crusade's troops…!)
m400517.（本当にホロウクルスの眷属に勝ってしまったのです……）: (We really did defeat the minions of the Hollow Crus…)

Do we really have to face

Well…… I suppose Zizi-san
will have to take responsibility and fight them.

Since we can't just leave you to it,
we'll join the fight along with you all.

m410576.思いどおりに悪戯が成功して、みんなを振り回して……。\n全部全部上手くいっちゃう:

with their weapons drawn as well!

――!?

as my beloved plaything!!

――Ah, I'm sorry for eavesdropping!

Whaaat?!

What's the matter, sighing so dramatically?

I'm sorry.

m500461.いや、気にしないでくれ。\nそれで、名案だという理由は？:
No, don't worry about it.
So, why do you think it's a good idea?

they used their warships to transport our units.

Huh, no, but…….
Doing a battle like that for such an arbitrary reason is…….

Huh? No, I'm the one who should be helping you――wait,
You left me behind again!!

Huh, huh, like this?!

m500461.これは……魔力の乗った波動です！\nポセイオスは、\n己の眷属を全海から呼び寄せ:

Poseios is
calling his kin from across the entire ocean!
m500461.しかし……同じ王国の仲間だ。\n戦友として、これまでも、これからも信頼はしている:

m500461.それじゃあ、戦勝記念パーティ第二弾しよー！！: Then, let's have a second victory celebration party!!

rebuilt by the Prince after he gathered the personnel.

After all, they reached the legendary Atlantis and defeated Poseidon, a god famed in the myths!
m500461.だめです！ 無理やりこじ開けられて……こんなの……。\n皆さん、これは夢じゃない:
I can't! I'm being forced open…… this isn't…….
Everyone, this isn't a dream!!

Tch…… so it's basically the real thing!
Prince, at least let me activate the mechanical giants――
m500461.ですが、もしその助力を得られなかったら、\nもっと酷い状況で決戦に挑むことになっ:

we would have faced the decisive battle in a far worse situation.
Isn't it a good thing to hold a simulation under those assumptions?

Delphina, please give me a hand♪

W-What do you mean?!
This Poseios is
just an illusion from a dream reconstructed from memory…….
m500461.はぁ……やれやれ……。: Haa……well, I suppose that's just how things are.

You know, using Chronosia's power to see the past, and
Reve's power to intervene in dreams.

My ears are ringing, you know?!

m500461.んっふっふ、いいね、いいね！\n照れた顔もいい感じ！:
Mmffufu, that's good, that's good!
Your blushing face looks nice too!

Kuku…… Haha, Gwahahaha!!
So, you wish to fight this Poseios again!!

Poseios interfering with the dream world…….

m500461.ポセイオスの残留思念……？\nいえ、魔力の塊が、私たちの意識に介入してきています:
Is it Poseios's residual thoughts……?

Alright, pirates, follow my lead!
We're not going to let the Navy have the last word!!

because we had Duo, a decisive trump card, on our side.

This is my domain, the bottom of the abyssal sea.
I shall show you the full extent of my power!!

the Great God who rules all the seas!!

Ah, yes!
The Shinobi who went ahead reported
that there was a Giant matching that description!
m940011.ああ、呪われているのはこの身のみ。\nタルタロスの深奥、深き虚ろより這い出た呪い:
Yes, only this body is cursed.
The curse that crawled out of the deep void of Tartarus
is devouring my soul.
m940011.ああ。俺の命ひとつで済むのなら構わないが、\nこのままでは帝国が滅びる。:
Aye. If it can be settled with just my life, I have no objection,
but as things stand, the Empire will be destroyed.
m940011.ああ。呪いの元凶は、タルタロスの奥にある。: Yes. The root of the curse lies deep within Tartarus.
m940011.ああ。気配がしないのではない。\nこれは、待ち伏せだ。:
Ah. It is not that there is no presence.
This is an ambush.
m940011.あいにくと、俺を孤独にさせたがらない友がいてな。\nいずれ、貴様の喉元に、我が剣:
Unfortunately, I have friends who refuse to let me be alone.
Someday, I will press my blade to your throat.
I look forward to that day with great anticipation.
m940011.あなたの覚悟は、よく分かりました。\nしかし門を越えたところで、問題は解決しませ:
I understand your resolve well enough.
But crossing the gate will not solve the problem.
m940011.あの……えっと……。: You don't have to hide back there... (pulling)
m940011.あのような個体が現れたことが、\n呪いがより強くなっている証左かと。: The fact that such an entity appeared is proof that the curse is intensifying.
m940011.あれはいわば、皇帝という鋳型を通して、\nタルタロスの魔力が形を得たものです。: That was merely Tartarus's magic taking shape through the mold of the Emperor.
m940011.いいえ、関連していると見て間違いないでしょう。: No, it is safe to assume they are related.
m940011.いいえ。門の前でお話ししたとおり、\n内部に踏み入ったなら、その瞬間に\n永遠の:
No. As I told you before the gate,
if you step inside, you will be swallowed
by the eternal cycle of time in that very instant. However—
m940011.いえ、起きたのは王国ではなく……。\n――緊急の伝令です！\n現在、白の帝国の都:
No, it is not the Kingdom that is in trouble...
――This is an urgent dispatch!
The cities of the White Empire are currently under attack by Giants!
m940011.いえ。礼なら、呼び声に応えたヒュリオンと、\nその身を捧げたキュクロプスの王へ。: You're welcome. If anyone deserves thanks, it's Hyrion for answering the call, and the King of the Cyclopes for giving his life.
m940011.いえいえ。\nそれはともかく、今夜は何か起こる気配がします。\nおふたりも十分に:
Please, don't worry about it.
That aside, I sense something is about to happen tonight.
Please stay on guard, both of you―
m940011.いったい何だったんだ、あれは。\n魔物にしては、何というのか、異質な感じだった。:
What on earth was that?
Even for a monster, it felt… alien.
m940011.いつまで、そのつよがりが保つものか――: Hyrion?: How long will that bravado last――
m940011.いや、なんでもない。\n助けてやらないと、と思っただけだ。:
No, nothing.
I just thought I should help him.
m940011.いや、もうさほど保たぬだろう。: No, I fear not much is left.
m940011.いや、皆、分かってくれるだろう。:
No. They will understand.
I failed to keep the oath of non-aggression... I am sorry... White Emperor...
m940011.うぅん、あの時よりも、魔力が濃くなってる。\n何かが明確に、冥界――そして物質界:
Hmm, the magical energy is even denser than it was back then.
I think something is clearly reaching out to the Underworld―
and to the material world.
m940011.うわぁ、目がどんよりギラついてますよ。: Wow, her eyes are all hazy and glowing.
m940011.えっ、門番ってことです？\nそれってカルペムと同じ役目じゃ……。:
Ehh, so you're a gatekeeper?
That's the same role as Carpem's, isn't it…
m940011.おお、おお、裁定者殿か。\n白の皇帝、裁定者殿、そして英雄と名高き王子。\nこれ:
Oh, oh, the Arbiter.
White Emperor, Arbiter, and the Prince famed as a hero.
If this is my end, I could not ask for a better one.
m940011.お姉ちゃん、巨人さんたちに\n滅茶苦茶失礼なこと言ってる自覚あります？:
Sis, do you have any idea how incredibly rude
that is to the Giants?
m940011.お姉ちゃんが警邏中にサボって寝てたからです！\nこの一族の恥！ 駄目姉！ 愚姉ー:
Because you were sleeping on the job during patrol!
You're a disgrace to our family! Useless big sister! Idiot sister!!
m940011.お姉ちゃんと逆方向に話通じないやつですね。: She's the exact opposite of your sister when it comes to talking sense into people.
m940011.お姉ちゃんのことですよ！\n――って、あっ、すみません、\nうちの愚姉がまたご迷:
You, big sister!
―Oh, I'm sorry,
our idiot sister is causing trouble again.
m940011.ここはタルタロス。\n如何なる理由があろうと、出入りは禁じられています。:
This is Tartarus.
Entry and exit are forbidden, no matter the reason.
m940011.このあたりに出現した魔物は、\nすべて倒せたようですね。:
It seems we've defeated all the monsters
that appeared in this area.
m940011.このままでは、ヒュリオンも\nキュクロプスの王と同じく……。:
...Is there any way to save him besides killing him?
Tell me. Anything, if there is even a slight chance.
m940011.この地の者たちは、好戦的な部族とは異なる。\n温厚で、戦いを好まない者たちだ。:
The people here are different from the warlike tribes.
They are gentle souls who have no love for battle.
m940011.これだけ濃い魔力を振りまいていれば、\n嫌でも正体がわかるというものよ。: With that much raw magical power radiating, it's impossible not to know what's behind it.
m940011.これほどの武技。\nここまでに、いったいどれだけの戦いを。:
Martial skill of this caliber.
How many battles have you fought to reach this point?
m940011.これを放置すれば、呪いはさらに拡大し、\nいずれ世界そのものを呑み込むでしょう。:
If this is left unchecked, the curse will continue to spread,
until it swallows the world itself.
m940011.これ以上……タルタロスの誇りを、\n穢させて、たまるものか……。:
I cannot allow the pride of Tartarus
to be defiled any further...
m940011.こんな市街地に魔物とは……。\n付近の詰め所に連絡を！\n市民に被害が出る前に討:
A monster in the city center…
Contact the nearby garrison!
We'll exterminate it before it harms the citizens!
m940011.こんな洞窟の奥に、巨人族の集落が……？: A Giant settlement deep inside a cave like this……?
m940011.さきほど、皇帝の姿を取った呪いを斬り捨てたのに……。: But we just cut down the curse that was wearing the Emperor's form…
m940011.さすがに、あれはただの姉妹喧嘩かと。\n昇進したというのに、彼女はいつもどおりで:
I suppose that was just a sibling quarrel, after all.
Despite her promotion, she's still the same as ever…
m940011.さて、今度は、俺が追う番だ。\nタルタロスより伸びたこの影、根こそぎ断ち斬る。:
Now, it is my turn to pursue.
I will cut down the shadow that stretches from Tartarus,
root and branch.
m940011.さらに、これはあくまで可能性の話ですが……。: Furthermore, this is purely a possibility, but…
m940011.されど、心残りは我が臣下たちよ。\nタルタロスには何の縁もない巨人たちまで、\n:
But I have one regret: my subjects.
Even the giants who had no connection to Tartarus
are being corroded by the curse that invades me.
m940011.しかし、この呪いを解くためには、\nやはりタルタロスの奥へ行くしかないのではない:
But to break this curse,
don't we have no choice but to venture deep into Tartarus?
m940011.しかし、だからといって\nあなた方を中へ入れる理由にはなりません。:
However, that does not give you
a reason to be let inside.
m940011.しかし創造神は、タルタロスに幽閉されし者たちに、\nひとつの救済を用意していまし:
However, the Creator prepared
one form of salvation for those imprisoned in Tartarus.
m940011.ぜぇ、はぁ……。\n無事任務完遂しましたよ！:
Phew... haah...
Mission accomplished, as promised!
m940011.そして我が同胞、永遠の牢獄から解き放たれ、\n新たな生を歩むことを許されたこの娘:
And my kin, this girl who was released from eternal imprisonment
and permitted to walk a new path in life,
will surely be swallowed by Tartarus again if things continue like this.
m940011.その原因を絶つことなく、\n踵を返すことはできません。:
We cannot turn back
without cutting off its source.
m940011.その呪いは例の泥を生み出し、\nそれらが周辺の魔力を歪めきったところで、\nより:
That curse generates the mud we saw,
and once it has thoroughly distorted the surrounding magical energy,
it takes the form of a shadow, manifesting as something far more powerful.
m940011.それが、あなたに刻まれた呪いであり、\n外部に干渉するための術式です。:
That is the curse engraved upon you,
a ritual formula for interfering with the outside world.
m940011.それで、あなたはどうするつもりで？: And what are you planning to do?
m940011.それでも、行くと言うのですか？: And yet, do you still intend to go?
m940011.それで十分だろう？: That concludes the damage report for the city under attack.
m940011.それにしても、よくできた妹がいると、\n姉はダメになるものなのでしょうか……。:
Still, does having a competent little sister
always make the older one slack off?
m940011.それらすべてが、先ほどご報告した\n「皇帝陛下の影」と関連しているかは、\nまだ: It is not yet clear whether all of these incidents are connected to the "Shadow of the Emperor" I mentioned earlier, but……
m940011.たたかいつづけよ。\n呪いを振りまき、孤独に、戦い続けよ。:
Hyrion?: Keep fighting.
Spread the curse, and fight on in solitude.
m940011.だからあれですよ。\nよく王国との合同演習で聞こえてくる――:
Well, you know.
The kind we often hear during the joint exercises with the Kingdom—
m940011.だからこそ、帝国は庇護下におきつつ、\nできるだけ干渉を避けていたのよね。:
That is precisely why the Empire placed them under its protection,
while doing its best to avoid interfering in their affairs.
m940011.だが、ティシファ、\n貴様も誰かを頼ることを覚えた方がいい。:
But, Tisipha,
you would do well to learn to rely on others, too.
m940011.だが、原因が分かっているのなら話は早い。: However, now that we know the cause, we can act swiftly.
m940011.だが、肝心の王の姿がどこにもないな……。: But the King himself is nowhere to be found...
m940011.っ、これは……！？: I see. Hyrion is also a reincarnate...
m940011.で、あれば、話は早い。\n我が使命はタルタロスの門を\n越えんとする者すべての断:
Then this will be quick.
My duty is to condemn all who attempt
to cross the gate of Tartarus.
m940011.では、ますますここを通すわけにはいきません。: Then I certainly cannot let you pass.
m940011.でも、どうして、\n無関係なあなたがそこまで――:
I've had enough of being left behind.
And of leaving others behind.
m940011.でも、様子が変です！\nなんだか目が虚ろで……。:
But something is wrong with them!
Their eyes look vacant...
m940011.どういうことだ。:
Even after reincarnating into the material world, the core of the soul
remains tethered to the prison of Tartarus.
m940011.なぜ、私の名を。: Why do you know my name?
m940011.なっ……！？\nキュクロプスの王が、自ら胸に刃を……。:
Wha...!?
The King of the Cyclopes is driving a blade into his own chest...
m940011.ならば、こちらから乗り込んで、\nその元凶を叩き斬るまでだ。: Then we shall march in ourselves and destroy it.
m940011.ならば、止めるしかあるまい。: Then we have no choice but to stop them.
m940011.なるほど、あなたが外の世界の門番でしたか。: I see. So you are the guardian of the gate to the outside world.
m940011.なるほど、常にタルタロスの魔力を注がれていると。\nどんな魔法でも\nこの呪いを:
I see. It is constantly being fed by the magic of Tartarus.
Now I understand why
no spell can break this curse…
m940011.なるほど。あなたのその影、そしてまとわりつく淀んだ気配。: I see. That shadow of yours, and the stagnant aura clinging to you.
m940011.なん、だ……？\n身体が、熱く……。:
What, is this……?
My body is burning……
m940011.はぁ……。切っても切ってもドロドロで、\nすごく気味が悪かったです……。:
Phew… No matter how much we cut it, it just oozed and oozed.
It was really creepy…
m940011.はぁ……断る余地はなさそうですね。: Haa… I suppose I have no room to refuse.
m940011.はっ。現在、帝都の各所で\n同様の「黒い泥」の目撃情報が相次いでいます。: Yes, sir. We are currently receiving reports of the same "black mud" appearing in various parts of the Imperial Capital.
m940011.はっ！ そんなことより大変なんですよ！\n皇帝陛下はこちらにいますか！？:
Hah! But that is not the important part!
Is His Imperial Majesty here!?
m940011.ば、馬鹿な……陛下！？\nいや、黒い泥が陛下の形を模しているというのか！？:
N-No way… Your Majesty?!
No, is the black sludge mimicking Your Majesty's form?!
m940011.ひっ……！？ へ、陛下の影から、\nあの黒い泥が……湧き出してる……！？: H-Huh……!? T-The black mud is……welling up from Your Majesty's shadow……!?
m940011.ひとまず帝都へ戻る。\n情報を整理し、打てる手を洗い出す。: For now, we return to the imperial capital. We need to organize the information and figure out what we can do.
m940011.ふたりとも、気を抜かないように。\nここから先は、何が起こるかわかりません。:
Both of you, don't let your guard down.
We have no idea what's waiting for us beyond this point.
m940011.ふふっ、別にからかったわけではないですよ。\nそれに私も、ずっと何か、嫌な予感が:
Heh, I wasn't trying to tease you.
Besides, I've had a bad feeling about something for a while now.
m940011.ほぇー。巨人族って、もっとこう、\nうおー！ どかーん！ って\n暴れてるイメー:
Oh, wow. I always imagined Giants were more like,
"Roar!" and "Boom!"
You know, just tearing everything up.
m940011.まぁまぁ、門なんてドカンと叩き壊せば、\n黒幕のところまで一直線に――:
Easy, easy. If we just smash the gates to pieces,
we can go straight to whoever's pulling the strings―
m940011.まだ仮説でしかありませんが――: It is still only a hypothesis, but――
m940011.まったく、きりがないな。\n無事にキャリーが援軍を連れてきてくれればいいが――:
Honestly, this is never-ending.
I just hope Carrie arrives safely with reinforcements――
m940011.まるで、立ち去った後のような……？: It is as if they have already left...?
m940011.まるで、陛下をタルタロスへ近づけまいと、\n足止めをしているかのようですね……。:
It's as if they're holding your feet back, Your Majesty…
Trying to keep you from getting any closer to Tartarus.
m940011.もし、その無限の苦しみの中で\n「死」を迎えることができた者がいたなら、\nその:
If one could meet "death"
amidst that infinite suffering,
their soul would be granted a new life in the material world.
m940011.もしかして、あなたは……ティシファ……？: Could it be that you are… Tisipha…?
m940011.ゆえに、あなた方を通すのではなく、\n私が、呪いの解決に助力します。:
Therefore, rather than letting you through,
I will be the one to assist in resolving the curse.
m940011.わっ、わっ……えっと、助けてくれて、ありがとう……？: W-wait… um, thank you for saving me…?
m940011.わわっと！？\nアネットじゃないですか。\nそんなに急いで、何かあったんですか？:
W-Whoa?!
Anette, is that you?
You look like you're in a hurry. Did something happen?
m940011.アネットのフェンリルが、\nまだ警戒態勢を解いていない……。:
Anette's Fenrir
still hasn't dropped its guard…
m940011.キュクロプスの王……。\n巨人の集落が、帝国領内の西の方にあったかも。:
The King of the Cyclopes…
I think there was a giant settlement in the western part of the Empire's territory.
m940011.キュクロプスの王、か。: So, the King of the Cyclopes...
m940011.キュクロプスの王、か。\nまだ理性は残っているのか？:
The King of the Cyclopes...
Do you still have any reason left?
m940011.キュクロプスの王が\n常にタルタロスの呪いを受けていたように、\n陛下にも、呪い:
Just as the King of the Cyclopes was constantly subjected to the curse of Tartarus,
the power of a curse continues to flow into Your Highness as well.
m940011.キュクロプスの王が、最後の理性で\n被害を抑えていたのだろう。:
Hyrion has also regained consciousness.
It seems we can consider this matter resolved.
m940011.キュクロプスの王の願いは、\n穏やかに、静かに、仲間と共に暮らすことだったそうだ:
The Cyclops King's wish was simply to live
peacefully, quietly, and alongside his kin.
……That is what the previous king told me.
m940011.キュクロプスの王よ、貴様の民に伝播している呪いは、\n貴様を止めれば消えるのか？:
King of the Cyclopes, will the curse spreading among your people
be lifted if I stop you?
m940011.タルタロスから物質界へ転生した、古い友です。\nきっと、私のことはもう、覚えてい:
He is an old friend who was reincarnated
from Tartarus into the material world.
He surely doesn't remember me anymore.
m940011.タルタロスという贖罪の牢獄から、\n外の世界へ腕を伸ばす者がいるのなら、\nそれ:
If there is someone reaching out from the prison of atonement known as Tartarus
toward the outside world,
it is my duty to condemn them.
m940011.タルタロスに由来する魔力は、\n呪いによって指向性をもたせられていますが、\n本:
The magical energy originating from Tartarus is given direction by the curse,
but in its original state, it is a purer force, closer to a primal power――
m940011.タルタロスの門の向こう、\n無数の封じられし者たちが溢れ出さぬよう、\n咎人を処:
I have heard that beyond the gate of Tartarus,
there is an arbiter who judges the guilty,
preventing the countless sealed ones from spilling out.
m940011.タルタロスは、死が訪れず、\n無限の生をループする牢獄です。:
Tartarus is a prison where death never comes,
and infinite life loops endlessly.
m940011.タルタロス内部は、物質界の生命が\n踏み入って無事で済むような環境ではありません:
The interior of Tartarus is not an environment
where life from the material world can enter and remain unharmed.
m940011.ディアナ、武力は貴様に任せる。\n場合によっては、そのまま皇帝の座を引き継げ。:
Diana, I leave the use of force to you.
If necessary, take the throne yourself.
m940011.ヒュリオンから、タルタロスの気配が消えていく……。: The presence of Tartarus is fading from Hyrion……
m940011.ヒュリオンの魔力反応も落ち着いています。\n呪いは無事に解けたみたいですね。:
Hyrion's magical reaction is stabilizing.
It seems the curse has been lifted.
m940011.ヒュリオンは、まだほとんど侵食されていません。\n今ならまだ、呪いの経路さえ断ち:
But why are you, a stranger,
going to such lengths...?
m940011.フッ……こんな状況の玉座でよければくれてやるが。: Fff… If you're willing to sit on a throne in this kind of mess, I'll hand it over.
m940011.ルー、お疲れ様。\n泥だらけになっちゃったね。\nあとで綺麗にしてあげるから。:
Lu, good job.
You're covered in mud.
I'll clean you up later.
m940011.一歩踏み入った瞬間から、\nあなたの時間が永遠に引き伸ばされ、\nそれ以上進むこ:
The moment you take that first step,
your time will be stretched out forever,
and you will be unable to advance any further.
m940011.不可侵とはすなわち、\n民にもその存在を伏せている、ということだからな。:
A pact of non-aggression means, in other words,
that their very existence is kept hidden from the people.
m940011.不可侵の誓い……守れず、すまぬ……白の皇帝よ……。:
No apology is needed.
You resisted to the very end. That is enough.
m940011.事情は理解しました。\n咎人でありながら物質界に手を伸ばす所業、\n私も決して許:
I understand your situation.
I, too, will never forgive a sinner for reaching into the material world.
m940011.以前、ハイドースが門を一瞬だけ開いた影響が\nまだ残っているのかしら。: Is it a lingering effect from when Hyades opened the gates for just a moment?
m940011.何だ、その聞き覚えのある悲鳴というのは。: What do you mean by a scream you recognize?
m940011.俺がここにいれば、帝都に\nタルタロス由来の怪物が溢れかえるかもしれないのだろう:
If I stay here, monsters born from Tartarus
might flood the capital, wouldn't they?
m940011.俺がどこかにとどまると、\nそこに俺の影が現れるということか。: So, wherever I stay, my shadow will appear there.
m940011.俺は止まるわけにはいかない。\n退かぬというなら、貴様ごと斬り伏せる！:
I cannot stop here.
If you refuse to move, I will cut you down!
m940011.元から、そんなに強がりなわけでもない。\nこんな夜には、人並みに警戒だってする。:
I wasn't always pretending to be tough.
On nights like this, I'm just as vigilant as anyone else.
m940011.光も温もりも届かない、\n時を永遠に繰り返し続ける牢獄。\n罪人はその檻の中、永:
A prison where neither light nor warmth can reach,
where time repeats itself in an endless loop.
The sinners are confined within those bars,
to be imprisoned forever.
m940011.全軍、俺に続け。\nこのまま一気に突破する。:
All units, follow me.
We're breaking through in one go.
m940011.冗談が言えるならまだ大丈夫そうですね。\n――アネット、この先の状況は？:
If you can still joke around, then you're doing fine.
―Anette, what's the situation ahead?
m940011.分かった。\nティシファと言ったか？:
Understood.
Was it Tisipha you said your name was?
m940011.初代のふたりにも、連絡を密に取るようにしろ。\nいざとなれば、必ず力になってくれ:
Keep in close contact with the two from the first generation as well.
If things get desperate, they will surely lend us their strength.
m940011.到着した時点で街壁が破壊されていたのが痛いな……。\n王子、東門はこちらで引き受:
It's a shame the city walls were already breached by the time we arrived...
Prince, we'll handle the East Gate.
Leave the defense of the plaza to us!
m940011.前に見た、皇帝陛下そっくりな影！！: A shadow that looks exactly like His Majesty the Emperor!
m940011.向こうから姿を見せてくれれば話は簡単だが……。: If they'd just show themselves, this would be easy…
m940011.向こうの区画で、黒いどろどろした魔物が出たの。\nあちこちに出現してるから、ここ:
A black, sludge-like monster appeared in the district over there.
It's popping up in multiple places, so it might show up here too.
m940011.呪いの泥って、無限に湧くのかしらねぇ？: Does the cursed mud just keep spawning endlessly?
m940011.命までは奪わん。そこをどけ。: I will not take your life. Move aside.
m940011.外の世界から……？ どういうことだ？: From the outside world…? What do you mean?
m940011.少なくとも、タルタロスの内部で\n何が起きているのか、\n多少なりとも知ることが:
At the very least, we should be able to learn
something about what is happening
inside Tartarus.
m940011.帝国軍！ 良かった、\n伝令は無事に届いたようだな。:
The Imperial Army! Good,
the messenger must have delivered the message safely.
m940011.幸い、王国軍が陣を張っていた場所が近かったため、\n現在王子が精鋭を率いて防衛に:
Fortunately, the Kingdom's army was stationed nearby,
so the Prince is leading an elite force to defend them!
m940011.建物はめちゃくちゃですが、\n人的被害がほとんどなかったのが幸いですね。:
The King of the Cyclopes likely used his last shred of reason
to minimize the damage.
m940011.心当たりがあるようだな。\nならば、そこを退け。:
You seem to know exactly what you are dealing with.
Then, move aside.
m940011.必ず、すべてを解決する。\n貴様の力を、貸してくれ。:
You must resolve this, no matter what.
Lend me your strength.
m940011.恩に着る。\n貴様の断罪、俺たちも手を貸すと誓おう。:
I accept your kindness.
I swear that we, too, will lend a hand in your condemnation.
m940011.我らは破壊神の被造物……。\n誇りをもって、世界の行く末を戦った、者……。:
We are the creations of the God of Destruction...
Those who fought for the fate of the world... with pride...
m940011.敵が俺の姿を取ろうと、関係ない。\nヒュリオンを呪いから解き放ち、\n俺の似姿を:
It does not matter if the enemy wears my face.
I will free Hyrion from the curse,
and strike down this imitation. ――Let us go.
m940011.敵の勢いが収まったな。\n今のうちに、タルタロスの門まで一気に抜けるぞ。:
The enemy's momentum is fading.
Let's push through to the Gates of Tartarus while we can.
m940011.止めても、聞いてくれそうにありませんね。: It seems you won't listen, even if I try to stop you.
m940011.死期が近い者同士、分かることもあるということだ。: Those whose end is near often understand each other.
m940011.民を守るためならば、\nどんな地獄であろうと踏み入る覚悟はできている。:
If it means protecting my people,
I am prepared to step into whatever hell awaits.
m940011.気の長い話だな……。: That sounds like it will take a long time…
m940011.決まりだ。\n――これよりキュクロプスの王の領地へ向かう。:
Then it's settled.
――We will head to the King of the Cyclopes' territory.
--- scene: The One Who Judges the Guilty (battle, start) ---
m940011.油断していると皇帝の座、簒奪しますよ。: If you let your guard down, I'll seize the throne.
m940011.準備を急げ。これより、\n冥界の深淵……タルタロスの門を目指す。: Prepare at once. We are heading for the gate to the abyss of the Underworld……Tartarus.
m940011.物質界に転生しても、その魂の根幹は、\n牢獄たるタルタロスに結びついています。:
If we do nothing, Hyrion will suffer the same fate
as the King of the Cyclopes...
m940011.王国のワルキューレだったな。\nどうした、王国になにか起きたのか？:
So you are the Valkyrie from the Kingdom.
What is it? Has something happened in the Kingdom?
m940011.現在、タルタロスに由来する呪いが\n物質界に影響を及ぼしています。:
Currently, a curse originating from Tartarus
is affecting the material world.
m940011.生きたまま足を踏み入れれば、\nその魂はたちまち摩耗し、\n永遠の苦しみを味わう:
If you step inside while still alive,
your soul will wear away in an instant,
and you will be forced to taste eternal suffering.
m940011.白の皇帝よ、どうか、我が民を――: White Emperor, please... save my people――
m940011.皆さん、警戒を。\n何かが潜んでいるのかもしれません！:
Everyone, stay alert.
Something might be lurking nearby!
m940011.皇帝。あなたの身にかかった呪いが、\nよりその深さを増しています。: Emperor. The curse on you is growing even deeper.
m940011.皇帝がこのまま帝都にとどまれば、\n呪いの泥が際限なく蔓延し、国を蝕むことになる: If the Emperor remains in the Imperial Capital, the cursed mud will spread without limit and devour the nation.
m940011.知らなくとも無理はない。\nこの地の巨人族と白の帝国は、\n互いに不可侵の誓いを:
It's no wonder you didn't know.
The Giants of this land and the White Empire
have exchanged a pact of non-aggression.
m940011.破壊神の誇りと、創造神の慈愛によって\n再び得たこの生を、臣下たちの未来の、礎に:
This life, regained through the pride of the God of Destruction
and the compassion of the God of Creation... shall be the foundation for my subjects' future...
m940011.確かに、それはタルタロスに封じられし、\n私たちに連なる魔力に違いありません。:
Indeed, that must be the power sealed within Tartarus,
the same power that binds us.
m940011.確かに、妙ですね。\nタルタロスの残り香、\n王の魂の気配は確かにあります。です:
Indeed, it is strange.
The lingering scent of Tartaros,
and the aura of the King's soul are definitely there. But...
m940011.私はタルタロスの門の、\n向こう側を求める者を阻む門番よ。\nでも、あの子は――:
I am the gatekeeper of Tartarus.
I bar the way to those who seek to pass beyond the gate.
But that one is――
m940011.私も服が泥だらけです……。\n帰ったら絶対にお風呂に長時間浸かりますからね……。:
My clothes are covered in mud, too….
I'm definitely going to soak in the bath for a long time when we get home…
m940011.端的に言えば、陛下はいま、\nタルタロスに閉じ込められた強大な魔力の、\nいわば:
To put it bluntly, Your Highness has become
something like a gate to the material world
for the immense magical energy sealed within Tartarus.
m940011.素直に立ち去るのであれば、危害は加えません。\nどうか、二度とここへは近づかぬよ:
If you will leave peacefully, I will do you no harm.
Please, do not come near here again.
m940011.総員、剣を取れ。奴らを制圧する。: All hands, draw your swords. Subdue them.
m940011.総員、警戒を強めろ。\n何が起きても即応できるようにしておけ。:
All hands, heighten your alertness.
Be prepared to respond instantly to whatever happens.
m940011.置いていかれるのも、置いていくのも、\nもう十分だと思ったから。: Is that not enough for you?
m940011.行くぞ、キュクロプスの王を、呪いから解き放つ。: Let's go. We will free the King of the Cyclopes from this curse.
m940011.街に出現した呪いの泥。\nその発生源は、皇帝にかけられた呪いそのもの。: The cursed mud appearing in the city. Its source is the curse placed upon the Emperor himself.
m940011.襲撃を受けている都市へ向かう。\n周辺都市にも早馬を出せ。:
I shall head to the city under siege.
Send riders to the surrounding towns at once.
m940011.言葉はわからないけど、\n何かを叫んでいるように見える。:
I can't understand the words, but
it looks like they're screaming for something.
m940011.記憶を残したまま転生することが可能かどうか、\nそれは私にもわかりませんが……。:
Whether it is possible to be reincarnated
while retaining one's memories…
I do not know that either…
m940011.誤魔化しても仕方ありません。\n仕組みはともかく、これは事実で間違いないかと。:
There is no point in dodging the question.
Regardless of the mechanism, this is an undeniable fact.
m940011.謝罪はいらん。\n最後まで抗ったなら、それで十分だ。:
Judithe, attend to the wounded.
With damage this severe, we must also rescue the civilians...
m940011.贖罪を終え、門を越えた魂はいくつか見てきました。\n最も新しい転生者であれば、「:
I have seen several souls that have completed their atonement and passed through the gate.
The most recent reincarnate should be the "King of the Cyclopes,"
reborn in the material world.
m940011.逃げた、移住した、色々可能性は考えられるけど……。: He could have fled, or relocated, there are a few possibilities...
m940011.邪魔をするなら蹴散らすまでだ。: If they get in our way, we'll smash them aside.
m940011.門が開いたのは一瞬だったというのに、\nよくもこれほどの呪いを外へ放ったものです:
Even though the gate was open for only an instant,
you managed to unleash a curse of this magnitude into the outside world.
m940011.陛下……ご自身の足元を、ご覧になってください。: Your Majesty……please look at your own feet.
m940011.陛下の影から泥が出てきているのではなくて、\n呪いそのものが通路のようになってし:
So it's not that mud is seeping out from under Your Highness's shadow…
the curse itself has become a pathway, hasn't it?
m940011.陛下の影だけでなく、どんな異常事態が発生するか、\n正直、未曾有の事態過ぎてまっ:
Beyond the issue of Your Highness's shadow,
it is honestly an unprecedented situation, so we have no idea what other anomalies might occur.
m940011.集落の規模はどれくらいなのでしょう？\n確かに誰かがよく通っているような痕跡はあ:
How large is the settlement, do you think?
There are certainly signs that someone passes through here often,
but if I had to put it, there is an unsettling absence of presence...
m940011.魂の内側まで、\nタルタロスの呪いに侵されているようです。\nこのままでは、もう:
The curse of Tartarus has invaded
even the innermost depths of his soul.
At this rate, there may be no hope...
m940011.（しかし、連中は何者なのか……。\n永遠の牢獄を暴かんとするのなら、この手で――:
???: (But who are these people…?
If they intend to break open the eternal prison, I will stop them with my own hands――)
m940011.（そうか、女神アイギス、\nケラウノスの加護を受けた王子と、\nアダマスの加護を:
(I see. The Goddess Aigis,
the Prince blessed by Keranos,
and the Emperor blessed by Adamas were all present……)
m940011.（私が目覚めたのは、偶然ではなかったらしい。\nまさか、タルタロスの門が開く日が:
??? : (It seems my awakening was no accident.
I never imagined the day the Gates of Tartarus would open would come.)
